programme.desc: S1 E14 — Arles James is in the city of Arles, famous for its Roman architecture and home to the largest market in Provence. James cooks a dish of John Dory using produce from the market.
programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Rome Starting her travels in Italy, Mary makes her first ever visit to Rome. A cuisine and cooking culture she has always adored, Italy's vibrant capital city offers some of the world's best food and produce. After a moped tour of the sights, she tries a delicious new take on traditional pizza, uncovers a hidden gem in Rome's old Jewish quarter and cooks a speedy Roman classic with Michelin started chef, Cristina Bowerman.
programme.title: Mary Berry's Quick Cooking

programme.desc: S1 E2 — The Festival Mary is joining the crowds and heading to her first ever music festival, but it's not the bands she has come for. She wants to explore the wonderful world of festival food pop-ups, seeing first-hand how these exciting outdoor cooks draw mega crowds.
programme.title: Mary Berry's Quick Cooking

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Marrakech Mary is heading to the hustle and bustle of Marrakech in Morocco. She immerses herself in the mayhem of the Medina on a mission to explore every side of Moroccan cuisine. In her own kitchen, she makes a lamb tagine, a spicy carrot hummus and a fresh summer salad.
programme.title: Mary Berry's Quick Cooking

programme.desc: S1 E4 — The Navy Mary is off to join the Navy on board one of its most powerful warships, the HMS Defender. Whilst the crew run a war training exercise on board the ship, Mary heads to the galley to see if she can help the kitchen team.
programme.title: Mary Berry's Quick Cooking

programme.desc: S1 E5 — West End Mary is out for a day, and a night, on the town. London's busy West End attracts millions of visitors every year, and Mary is joining them as she seeks out the secrets of getting busy people fed quickly and well. She will discover the art of high speed wok cooking in Chinatown, sample the delicious sweet treats being made daily from London's first ever patisserie before catching a show and a late night cocktail with some of its cast.
programme.title: Mary Berry's Quick Cooking

programme.desc: S1 E6 — The Airport Mary is given an access-all-areas pass as she heads behind the scenes at Heathrow airport. She wants to see how the restaurants and cafes feed the 80 million people that pass through the terminals each year in record-breaking time.
programme.title: Mary Berry's Quick Cooking

programme.desc: S1 E1 — From the Garden Mary shows that people do not need vast amounts of space, only a passion for bringing incredible flavours to life. Mary cooks up aubergine caponata, vegetable noodle soup, and her chicken and herb casserole.
programme.title: Mary Berry - Love to Cook

programme.desc: S1 E2 — New Tastes Mary meets father and son duo Mike and Joe of One Planet Pizza, who have turned their passion into a successful business. Next stop for Mary is the restaurant Chishuru, run by Adejoke Bakare in the heart of the vibrant Brixton Market.
programme.title: Mary Berry - Love to Cook

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Episode 3 Mary meets those who get great pleasure out of cooking for a crowd. In Liverpool, she joins the remarkable team from Homebaked Bakery, a goal kick away from Liverpool FC's stadium, who take on the job of feeding fans on match day.
programme.title: Mary Berry - Love to Cook

programme.desc: S1 E4 — For Family & Friends Mary teams up with her daughter Annabel as they head to Carmarthen Bay to meet forager Craig Evans. Armed with his vast knowledge of edible plants, they indulge in their two loves, the great outdoors and cooking.

programme.desc: S1 E15 — L'Isle sur la Sorgue James's journey brings him to the adopted home of his hero Keith Floyd - the riverside town of L'Isle sur la Sorgue, where Floyd once had a restaurant.
programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure

programme.desc: S1 E16 — Normandy James's journey takes him to Pegasus Bridge - famous for the D-Day landings. In one of Normandy's many apple orchards, James prepares a dish of artichokes with hollandaise.
programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure

programme.desc: S8 E3 — Bread Week The bakers are instructed to make 12 teacakes in the signature challenge. For the technical challenge, the bakers are tasked to make a cottage loaf. For the showstopper challenge, the bakers are required to make a multicoloured bread sculpture.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.desc: S8 E4 — Caramel Week For the first signature challenge, the bakers are required to produce 18 identical millionaire shortbread bars. Prue Leith tasks the bakers with making 12 stroopwafels. For the final showstopper challenge, the bakers make a caramel cake.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.desc: S8 E5 — Pudding Week For the signature challenge, the eight remaining bakers bake a steamed school pudding. Paul Hollywood asks the bakers to bake six molten chocolate puddings with peanut butter filling. For the showstopper, the bakers bake an ornamental trifle terrine.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.desc: S8 E6 — Pastry Week In the signature challenge, the bakers produce four decorative savoury pies. Paul asks the bakers to prepare 12 pastéis de nata. For the final showstopper, the bakers are required to make a family-sized hand-raised pie with a savoury filling.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.desc: S8 E7 — Italian Week The bakers are given two and a half hours to make the required 18 Sicilian Cannoli. Prue Leith tasks the bakers with making Pizza Margherita with a thin crispy base. For the showstopper, the bakers need to make twenty-four Sfogliatelle.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.desc: S8 E8 — Forgotten Bakes Week The bakers are required to make four Bedfordshire Clangers. Paul Hollywood asks the bakers to make a traditional Cumberland Rum Nicky. For the historic showstopper, the bakers have three and a half hours to make a Victorian Savoy cake.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.desc: S2 E13 — Wok It Out Adam is on the hunt for secret eats in Hong Kong, including a giant off-menu tomahawk steak at a hard-to-spot pub, a hidden tearoom's signature soup and wings at a secret speakeasy hidden inside a stamp shop.
programme.title: Secret Eats With Adam Richman

programme.desc: S2 E1 — Undercover 'Que Adam sleuths out London's tastiest secret eats, like a speakeasy disguised as a detective agency, a sundae that requires customers to dance, a limited-supply barbecue sandwich and a restaurant hidden inside an antique market.
programme.title: Secret Eats With Adam Richman

programme.desc: S2 E2 — Raising the Steaks Adam heads to Argentina in search of secret eats. He samples French toast from a steampunk speakeasy, an off-menu Mendozan stew served in a pumpkin and lamb loin from a secret closed-door restaurant inside a chef's flat.
programme.title: Secret Eats With Adam Richman

programme.desc: S2 E12 — Top Secrets Tacos Adam is on the hunt for secret eats in Mexico City. He finds an off-the-menu barbecue brisket sandwich and tacos in a secret speakeasy. He even finds lamb barbacoa cooked underground at a restaurant hidden in an ancient cave.
programme.title: Secret Eats With Adam Richman

programme.desc: S2 E7 — San Francisco Paul visits San Francisco, home to one of America's most iconic bakes, the sourdough. Inspired by a visit to a historic focaccia bakery, Paul creates savoury bread and butter pudding, and cheese and olive bread.
programme.title: Paul Hollywood City Bakes

programme.desc: S1 E6 — Tommy Banks Prue welcomes award-winning chef Tommy Banks as she makes two-tone soups and is joined in the kitchen by her husband John for a goat curd and tomato galette.

programme.desc: S2 E1 — Cake Twelve of the country's best amateur bakers take part in the second series of "The Great British Bake Off". In the first round, the bakers are challenged to make 24 decorated cupcakes in two hours and the stress soon shows. Next, they face a technical challenge - featuring a coffee and walnut Battenberg cake from one of Mary Berry's recipes - and finally, they have to make and bake a tiered showstopper cake.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.desc: S2 E2 — Tarts It's the second round and eleven bakers remain. This time their pastry skills are scrutinized as the bakers tackle tarts. Over two days the bakers will face three increasingly complicated challenges whilst trying to avoid a soggy bottom. Judged by acclaimed master baker Paul Hollywood and legendary cookery writer and baker Mary Berry.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

He's taking his gun dog Cooper to a training session at Laverstoke before cooking an amazing seasonal dish of partridge with vegetables and a sloe gin sauce. James hangs out with his best friend Jody Scheckter, an ex-Formula One racer with an epic car collection, and a surprising passion for buffalo mozzarella.

programme.desc: S1 E16 — Kent James' culinary tour of Great Britain continues as he explores the South East and the county of Kent. Here he meets up with local chef and restaurateur Mark Sargeant. Mark grew up in Kent and now owns four restaurants across the county. James cooks on the regenerated Folkestone Harbour Arm, making his BBQ herring and salsa. Mark then visits Dockers Bakehouse and Brewery - his local sourdough and beer suppliers located in a shipping container.
programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure

programme.desc: S1 E6 — Northumberland The Hairy Bikers continue their northern odyssey in the county of Northumberland. It's an area that Si knows well, having holidayed there many times throughout his childhood, and he is keen to introduce Dave to some of the producers and chefs he has got to know over the years. Starting in the seaside town of Amble, where they eat fresh seafood from the North Sea, they head to a potato farm at the foot of the Cheviot Hills that grows nine different varieties of potato.

programme.desc: S5 E3 — Middle Italy Molly's old band stops by the farm for a home-cooked meal, including orecchiette with broccolini and sausage, and a simple escarole salad with artichokes and tangy lemon dressing.
programme.title: Girl Meets Farm

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Episode 3 Jamie Oliver tantalises the taste buds with sesame and miso salmon, no-cook pasta sauce, a gnarly lamb madras traybake, no-fuss fish cakes and a hot and crispy ice cream parcel.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back to Basics

programme.desc: S2 E3 — Bread The baker's bread making skills are tested with three increasingly complicated challenges over two days. They start with the signature bake, a free-form flavoured loaf that produces a variety of interesting results. The technical challenge is focaccia, which really separates the wheat from the chaff. Finally, a mammoth six-hour hour challenge requires the bakers to create a display bread basket.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.desc: S2 E4 — Biscuits The bakers take on biscuits and these bite-sized, delicate delights prove too much for some. The remaining eight must impress legendary cookery writer Mary Berry and artisan baker Paul Hollywood with their interpretation of a classic biscuit. Who will crumble when it comes to judging and whose ginger nuts are too hot to handle?
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.desc: S1 E17 — Isle of Wight James continues his British adventure by taking to the seas and travelling across the Solent to explore the Isle of Wight with Hampshire chef Lenny Carr-Roberts. James sets up at The Hut Café Colwell to cook up a dish of Isle of Wight prawns with tomatoes, mangalitza chorizo and pancetta. Lenny takes a trip to the other side of the island in search of James' favourite sausage roll, made by WW Woodford and Sons Butchers in Bembridge.
programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure

programme.desc: S1 E18 — Bristol James' culinary adventure hits the South West of England with a visit to the food capital of this region, the vibrant city of Bristol. Here he meets up with local chef Romy Gill who gives James a guided tour of this incredible place. Their first stop is Wapping Wharf, a series of shipping containers housing everything from a butcher to a cheese-monger. After a bit of shopping, James pitches up his mobile kitchen overlooking the iconic Clifton Suspension Bridge to make a tagine of lamb chops.
programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure

programme.desc: Dramatic storylines, neon lights and iconic fashions. These are the music videos that made the 80s.

programme.desc: Direct from the pages of Smash Hits these are the bedroom pin-ups of the 80s.

programme.desc: A music video playlist featuring a collection of sexy songs to get the viewer in the mood.

programme.desc: Dramatic storylines, big dance routines, neon lights and iconic fashions, these are the classic music videos that made 1980.
programme.title: 1980 Unleashed!

programme.desc: Hits and headlines from the year of Barbara Woodhouse, Button Moon and Metal Mickey, and when Steven Gerrard was born as Liverpool were crowned league champions!

programme.desc: You may remember the artists, but do you recall their lesser heard songs? With The Tourists, Elvis Costello, Dexys, Dr Hook & Donna Summer.
programme.title: 1980's Lesser-Heard-Hits!

programme.desc: Todd Carty and Erkan Mustafa - otherwise known as Grange Hill's Tucker and Roland - host the ultimate school disco! But as they prop up the bar, will anyone else turn up?
programme.title: Tucker & Roland's School Disco 50!

programme.desc: All killer - no filler! The anthems that made a decade - from Madonna to Prince, Michael to George, Duran Duran to Pet Shop Boys.
programme.title: Only the Biggest 80s Anthems!

programme.desc: These odd songs seemed to come from nowhere, but left a lasting mark - sometimes good, but often quite bad. Watch out for a chorus of frogs, male strippers... oh, and Su Pollard!

programme.desc: A cavalcade of clothing calamities and 'interesting choices' from superstars including Bowie, Madonna, Adam Ant, Bananarama, Queen, Wham, Five Star and maybe even Limahl himself!

programme.desc: This is the soundtrack to your Christmas festivities - 80s style! Only the big party and sing-along tunes back to back!

programme.desc: From shoulder pads and chunky pullovers to dodgy beards, suspect eyeshadow and hoop earrings - the 80s were a juggernaut of excess! Here are 40 videos which defined the era.

programme.desc: The playlist features a selection of hair-raising hits from the eighties.

programme.desc: Pop legend Toyah brings 30 memorable videos featuring a cavalcade of clothing calamities from superstars including Bowie, Madonna, Adam Ant and many more in this crazy countdown!
programme.title: Toyah's Sack The Stylist?! Top 30

programme.desc: This is the soundtrack to your Christmas festivities - 80s style! Only the big party and sing-along tunes back to back!
programme.title: We're Feelin' 80s All Over!

programme.desc: We challenge you not to sing along to some of the biggest pop choruses of the '80s. From Black's 'Wonderful Life' to Baltimora's 'Tarzan Boy' - you'll need to turn this up loud!
programme.title: 25 Dead Catchy Choruses!

programme.desc: Another episode of the Heritage Chart - new music by heritage acts! With Mike Read.

programme.desc: Popcorn at the ready, these are NOW 80s' biggest songs from the movies. But don't forget to switch off those mobile phones!

programme.desc: Dramatic storylines, big dance routines, neon lights & iconic fashions - these are the classic music videos that made 1986!

programme.desc: 60 minutes of hits & headlines from the year of the Mexican World Cup, Bobby Ewing's shower scene and Den & Angie's Xmas Day divorce!

programme.desc: You may remember the artists, but do you recall their lesser heard songs? With New Order, Queen, Depeche Mode & Janet Jackson.

programme.desc: They say 2 heads are better than one & in the 80s the charts were full of collaborations. So pour a large one & have double the fun with Pat Sharp's top 40 duets.

programme.desc: Before the CD, the perfect pop songs were spun by singers and bands on 7 inch vinyl. From 1980-1984 these were the classic UK hits that invaded the world!

programme.desc: Timmy's back with something a little different - a run through of his favourite '80s bands, many interviewed on his 'Timmy on the Tranny' radio show throughout the decade!

programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

programme.title: Password
programme.desc: Starring Jimmy Fallon and hosted by Keke Palmer, the iconic word-guessing game features celebrities teaming up with everyday contestants. These teams play a modern and refreshed version of the game that's inspired by classic Password, Password Plus, Super Password and the viral celebrity Password games seen on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon. Players compete over three rounds of gameplay, taking turns trying to get their partner to guess the password using one-word clues. The team with the most points after two rounds heads to the bonus round, where they have 60 seconds to get the celebrity guests to correctly guess 10 passwords for a chance to win as much as $25,000.

programme.title: Password
programme.desc: Starring Jimmy Fallon and hosted by Keke Palmer, the iconic word-guessing game features celebrities teaming up with everyday contestants. These teams play a modern and refreshed version of the game that's inspired by classic Password, Password Plus, Super Password and the viral celebrity Password games seen on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon. Players compete over three rounds of gameplay, taking turns trying to get their partner to guess the password using one-word clues. programme.desc: When petty criminal Luke Jackson is sentenced to two years in a Florida prison farm, he doesn't play by the rules of either the sadistic warden or the yard's resident heavy, Dragline, who ends up admiring the new guy's unbreakable will. Luke's bravado, even in the face of repeated stints in the prison's dreaded solitary confinement cell, 'the box' makes him a rebel hero to his fellow convicts and a thorn in the side of the prison officers.

programme.desc: Sweeping epic about three sons raised on a Montana ranch by their father, a colonel who has turned his back on the army after the Indian Wars. Covering several decades, the action ranges from majestic Montana to the battlefields of Europe and adventure on the high seas.

programme.title: Friends

Exasperated, Phoebe takes the bowl of everyone's tickets and threatens to throw it off the balcony. The others make up, but a pigeon startles Phoebe.
programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

Also, Monica's hair problems go from bad to worse, and Phoebe has some bad news for Mike's girlfriend on her birthday.
programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Tales of the Unexpected

programme.desc: S5 E13 — James Brown A fascinating look at the life and career of James Brown, known as the 'Godfather of Soul', whose hits 'Papa's Got a Brand New Bag' and 'I Got You (I Feel Good)' made him one of the most iconic figures in music.
programme.title: Discovering Music

programme.desc: S5 E14 — Stevie Wonder Music journalists examine the life and music of Stevie Wonder, the pioneering American singer-songwriter whose hits include 'You Are the Sunshine of My Life' and 'Superstition'.

programme.desc: S1 E9 — The Way Up to Heaven A woman with a deeply held fear of not being punctual finds herself tormented by her husband on a troubled trip to the US, but she soon gets the chance to exact revenge on her cruel spouse.
programme.title: Tales of the Unexpected

programme.desc: S2 E10 — Depart in Peace Hearing from his old friend Gladys Ponsonby of the talented yet unconventional artist John Royden, art dealer Lionel gets Royden to visualise Lionel's fiancée Janet nude and paint her accordingly.
programme.title: Tales of the Unexpected

programme.desc: S3 E12 — Miss Paisley's Cat A lonely woman (Dorothy Stickney) believes she has murdered the man (Fred Graham) who killed her cat.
